definitions.full: H3465. yashan יָשָׁן adjective old (originally, as it seems, withered, flabby , like a lifeless plant with top hanging down, as if in sleep; compare Niph`al above, and Late Hebrew יָשַׁן Pi`el let a thing grow old ) — יָשָׁן Lev 25:22 3 t.; feminine יָשָׁנָה Isa 22:11 2 t.; plural יְשָׁנִים Cant 7:14; — old: הַיְשָׁנָה הַבְּרֵכָה 22:11 ; הַיְשָׁנָה שַׁעַר Neh 3:6 ; so 12:39 ; of choice fruits, Cant 7:14 (opposed to חדשׁ ); substantive old harvest, store , Lev 25:22 (twice in verse); 26:12 (twice in verse) (H; opposed to חדשׁ ).
